heading: Identifiers
text:
## Identifiers [LLEX.10]

```
LOWER     ::= 'a'..'z'
UPPER     ::= 'A'..'Z'
DIGIT     ::= '0'..'9'

NAME           ::= <XID identifier, NFC-normalized; XID_Start (∪ '_') narrowed
                   by UAX #39 Identifier_Status, then XID_Continue; pinned
                   Unicode version per [LNAM.2.2.5]; realized per [LLEX.10.8]>
TYPE_SYM       ::= <the NAME class plus the non-XID unit glyphs (° ′ ″ % …);
                   type positions only; realized per [LLEX.10.8]>
```
